title: 45-5-206. Partner or family member assault.

paragraphs.text: A person commits the offense of partner or family member assault if the person:
purposely or knowingly causes bodily injury to a partner or family member;
negligently causes bodily injury to a partner or family member with a weapon; or
purposely or knowingly causes reasonable apprehension of bodily injury in a partner or family member.
For the purposes of 45-5-206, 'family member' means spouses, former spouses, persons having a child in common, and persons who have been or are currently in a dating relationship.

history: History: En. Sec. 1, Ch. 426, L. 1985; amd. Sec. 1, Ch. 448, L. 1989; amd. Sec. 1, Ch. 350, L. 1995.

paragraphs.text: A person who knowingly subjects another person to any sexual contact without consent commits the offense of sexual assault.
Except as provided in subsections (3) and (4):
on a first conviction for sexual assault, the offender shall be fined an amount not to exceed $1,000 or be imprisoned in the county jail for a term not to exceed 1 year, or both;
